D: A drunk, grumpy superhero lets a PR man help fix his image, until a secret comes out.
P: Serve the mains when Hancock comes over for dinner at Ray's house.
S: Green prawns grilled with garlic, chilli, lime and butter
Prawns tossed in garlic, chilli, lime and melted butter, grilled 2 minutes a side until charred, piled high with lime wedges.
Toasted baguette rubbed with garlic, topped with tomato and basil
Toasted baguette rubbed with garlic and piled with chopped ripe tomato, basil and good olive oil.
Prison yard toasted cheese and pickle
Hancock doing his time in prison

Sharp cheddar and tangy pickle toasted in buttered bread until golden and oozing, cut into squares and lined up on a canteen tray. Butter one side of 8 slices of bread. Lay 4 slices butter side down and spread each with 1 tbsp sweet pickle relish. Top with 200g grated vintage cheddar, then the remaining bread, butter side up. Cook in a frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melted. Cut each into 4 squares and line them up on a tray.
M: dinner with Ray, Mary and their son

Parmesan beef meatballs simmered in a slow tomato and basil sauce over spaghetti, with crisp garlic bread and a green salad. Mix 600g beef mince, 50g breadcrumbs, 40g parmesan, 1 egg, parsley and salt and roll 20 meatballs. Brown in olive oil. Soften 3 garlic cloves and 1 onion, add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and basil, simmer 20 minutes, then add the meatballs for 20 minutes more. Split a baguette, spread with 60g butter mashed with garlic and parsley and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Cook 500g spaghetti and serve with salad leaves.
Grilled sirloin in a cracked pepper cream sauce, thick chips
Sirloin steaks grilled to medium-rare and rested, with a cream and cracked peppercorn sauce, thick chips cooked twice and a green salad.
W: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies cut into squares
Fudgy chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into squares with a scoop of ice cream.
K: Whisky, lemon juice, sugar syrup and egg white shaken

Whisky shaken hard with fresh lemon, sugar syrup and egg white until silky and foamy, poured over ice with bitters on top. For each drink, add 50ml whisky, 25ml fresh lemon juice, 15ml sugar syrup and half an egg white to a shaker. Shake hard without ice for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake again for 10 seconds. Strain into a short glass over fresh ice and shake 3 drops of bitters onto the foam. Make four, using 200ml whisky in total. For the sober version, make iced tea with lemon and honey.

dishes.make_ahead: Toss the prawns with the garlic, chillies, zest and butter up to 3 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; grill just before serving

steps.text: Toss the prawns with garlic, chopped red chillies, lime zest and melted butter.
Grill for a couple of minutes a side until charred.
Pile high on a platter with lime wedges and pour over any butter left in the pan.

veg.make_ahead: Score and marinate the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; grill on the night

steps.text: Halve the mushrooms lengthways, score the cut side and toss with garlic, chopped red chillies, lime zest and melted butter.
Grill for 3 minutes a side until charred and tender.
Pile high on a platter with lime wedges and pour over any butter left in the pan.

dishes.make_ahead: Toast the slices up to 1 day ahead and keep them airtight; mix the tomato topping up to 2 hours ahead and pile on just before serving

steps.text: Slice the baguette and toast the slices.
Mix the tomatoes with one crushed garlic clove, basil, olive oil and salt.
Rub the toasts with the cut garlic clove and pile the tomato on just before serving.

dishes.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 1 day ahead and keep them in cold water in the fridge, dried well before frying; cook the steaks and sauce on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips.
Fry twice in the oil until crisp.
Grill the steaks to medium-rare and rest.
In the pan, toast the peppercorns, add the cream and simmer until thick.
Serve with the chips and a green salad.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 1 day ahead and keep them in cold water in the fridge, dried well before frying; cook the mushrooms and sauce on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips.
Fry twice until crisp.
Brush the mushrooms with the olive oil and grill for 4 minutes a side until tender.
In the pan, toast the peppercorns, add the cream and simmer until thick.
Serve with the chips and a green salad.
Melt the chocolate with the butter.
Whisk in the sugar and eggs, then fold in the flour.
Bake in a lined tin at 170C.
Cool slightly, cut into squares and serve warm with ice cream. Good job.

dishes.make_ahead: Squeeze the lemon juice and make the sugar syrup up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; shake each drink to order

steps.text: For each drink, measure 50ml whisky, the juice of 1 lemon, 15ml sugar syrup, 1 egg white and 1 dash bitters into a shaker.
Shake each drink without ice for 10 seconds.
Add ice and shake again, then strain into a short glass over fresh ice.
Shake drops of bitters onto the foam. For the sober version, make iced tea with lemon and honey.

af.make_ahead: Tea up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, discard them, stir in the vanilla and chill.
For each drink, measure 50ml cold tea, the juice of 1 lemon, 15ml sugar syrup and half an egg white into a shaker.
Shake each drink without ice for 10 seconds.
Add ice and shake again, then strain into a short glass over fresh ice.
Dust the foam with a little cinnamon.

s.note: Green prawns grilled with garlic, chilli, lime and butter
s.how: Toss 600g green prawns with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli, lime zest and melted butter. Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred. Pile high on a platter with lime wedges and pour over any butter left in the pan. Eat with your fingers.

s.note: Toasted baguette rubbed with garlic, topped with tomato and basil
s.how: Slice 1 baguette and toast the slices. Dice 4 ripe tomatoes and mix with 1 crushed garlic clove, a handful of torn basil, 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Rub the toasts with a cut garlic clove and pile the tomato on just before serving.

m.note: Grilled sirloin in a cracked pepper cream sauce, thick chips
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry twice until crisp. Grill 4 sirloin steaks to medium-rare and rest. In the pan, toast cracked peppercorns, add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Serve with the chips and a green salad.

w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies cut into squares
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour. Bake in a lined tin at 170C for 25 minutes. Cut into squares and serve each warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Good job.

d.note: Whisky, lemon juice, sugar syrup and egg white shaken
d.how: For each drink, add 50ml whisky, 25ml fresh lemon juice, 15ml sugar syrup and half an egg white to a shaker. Shake hard without ice for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake again for 10 seconds. Strain into a short glass over fresh ice and shake 3 drops of bitters onto the foam. Make four, using 200ml whisky in total. For the sober version, make iced tea with lemon and honey.
